## Technical Audit Report: GameForge Data Structures & APIs

### 1. RULE OBJECTS
**Fields (interface Rule):**
- `id: number`
- `projectId: number`
- `title: string` (required, <60 chars per AI generation)
- `content: string` (required, <400 chars per AI guidance)
- `category?: string | null` (enum: "movement", "combat", "economy", "turn_structure", "variant")
- `priority: number` (0–5, default 1)
- `section?: string | null` (thematic grouping, ≤30 chars, normalizes empty string to null)
- `displayOrder: number` (auto-sequenced for drag-reorder)
- `designNotes?: string | null` (<200 chars, AI-generated intent explanation)
- `edgeCases?: string | null` (<200 chars, bullet-point exceptions separated by ' • ')
- `createdAt: Date`
- `updatedAt: Date`

**Form fields (rules.tsx):** title, content, category (select), priority (0–5), section (autocomplete)

---

### 2. ENTITY OBJECTS
**Fields (interface Entity):**
- `id: number`
- `projectId: number`
- `name: string`
- `type: string` (physical: Card, Deck, Token, Die, Tile, Meeple, Board; world: Location, Faction, Event, Resource, Ability)
- `subtype?: string | null`
- `parentEntityId?: number | null` (for parent-child hierarchy)
- `description?: string | null`
- `stats?: string | null` (slash-separated: "Health 10 / Damage 5"; parsed to {key, val} pairs)
- `color?: string | null` (hex color for UI rendering)
- `relatedTo?: string | null` (semicolon/comma-separated entity names)
- `lore?: string | null`
- `designNotes?: string | null`
- `status: string`
- `displayOrder?: number | null`
- `createdAt: Date`
- `updatedAt: Date`

**EntityProperty (nested):**
- `id: number`, `entityId: number`, `name: string`, `dataType: string` (e.g. "number")
- `unit?: string | null`, `value?: number | null`, `textValue?: string | null`
- `minValue?: number | null`, `maxValue?: number | null`, `defaultValue?: number | null`

---

### 3. PLAYTEST SESSION OBJECTS
**Fields (interface PlaytestSession):**
- `id: number`
- `projectId: number`
- `date: Date`
- `playerCount?: number | null`
- `durationMinutes?: number | null`
- `rating?: number | null` (1–5)
- `notes?: string | null`
- `issues?: string | null`
- `positives?: string | null`
- `suggestions?: string | null`
- `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date`

**PlaytestFeedback (public feedback):**
- `id: number`, `projectId: number`
- `respondentName?: string | null`
- `funScore?: number | null`, `balanceScore?: number | null`, `clarityScore?: number | null`
- `whatWorked?: string | null`, `whatDidNot?: string | null`, `suggestions?: string | null`
- `createdAt: Date`

---

### 4. SIMULATOR RESULT
**SimulatorResult shape:**
- `healthScore: number` (0–100 estimate)
- `verdict: string` (text assessment)
- `meanFinal: number` (average final player state)
- `bankruptRate: number` (decimal 0–1)
- `turns: SimulatorResultTurnsItem[]` (per-turn percentiles)

**SimulatorResultTurnsItem:**
- `turn: number`, `p10: number`, `p50: number`, `p90: number` (percentiles)

---

### 5. API HOOKS & ENDPOINTS

**Rules:** `useListRules()`, `useCreateRule()`, `useUpdateRule()`, `useDeleteRule()`, `useReorderRules()`, `useAiGenerateRules()`, `useAiEnhanceRule()`, `useConflictCheckRules()`, `useListRuleEntities()`
- Endpoints: GET/POST `/projects/{id}/rules`, PATCH `/rules/reorder`, PATCH `/rules/{ruleId}`, DELETE, POST `/rules/ai-generate`, POST `/rules/{ruleId}/enhance`

**Entities:** `useListEntities()`, `useCreateEntity()`, `useUpdateEntity()`, `useDeleteEntity()`, `useListEntityProperties()`, `useCreateEntityProperty()`, `useUpdateEntityProperty()`, `useDeleteEntityProperty()`, `useAiGenerateEntities()`, `useAiEnhanceEntity()`
- Endpoints: GET/POST `/projects/{id}/entities`, PATCH/DELETE `/{entityId}`, property CRUD at `/properties`

**Playtesting:** `useListPlaytestSessions()`, `useCreatePlaytestSession()`, `useDeletePlaytestSession()`, `useGetPlaytestShareLink()`, `useListPlaytestFeedback()`
- Endpoints: GET/POST `/projects/{id}/playtest-sessions`, DELETE `/{sessionId}`, GET `/share-link`, GET `/feedback`

**Simulator:** Direct fetch calls (not wrapped in hooks)
- Endpoints: POST `/projects/{id}/simulator/run` (Monte Carlo), POST `/simulator/playthrough` (AI stream with optional focus)

---

### Key Integration Points
- Rules may link to Entities via `useListRuleEntities(ruleId)`
- Sections auto-group rules by matching thematic names
- AI enhancement applies narrative context from project seed
- Simulator accepts iterations/turns count; streams playthrough as SSE

import { integer, pgTable, serial, text, timestamp } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { createInsertSchema } from "drizzle-zod";
import { z } from "zod/v4";
import { projects } from "./projects";

export const changelogEntries = pgTable("changelog_entries", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  projectId: integer("project_id")
    .notNull()
    .references(() => projects.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  actor: text("actor"),
  action: text("action").notNull(),
  entityKind: text("entity_kind"),
  entityRef: text("entity_ref"),
  summary: text("summary").notNull(),
  details: text("details"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
});

export const insertChangelogEntrySchema = createInsertSchema(
  changelogEntries,
).omit({
  id: true,
  createdAt: true,
});

export type ChangelogEntry = typeof changelogEntries.$inferSelect;
export type InsertChangelogEntry = z.infer<typeof insertChangelogEntrySchema>;
